messages:
Jin (Design): quick design review — proposing an "Undo safeguard" pattern for rollbacks/canaries. attached mock. needs copy, timing, placement, accessibility notes. thoughts? Sam (Product): good idea. goal: make accidental rollouts easy to revert. suggest a short-lived banner. 10s or 15s? lean 15s for slower keyboards. :thinking_face: Luca (Eng): client-side timer + /rollouts/:id/undo endpoint. 15s fine. avoid stealing focus when banner appears. Priya (Accessibility): do not steal focus. use aria-live (status) to announce: "Rollback initiated. You can undo within 15 seconds." Banner must be keyboard reachable and have visible focus ring. respect prefers-reduced-motion. Marta (Design): microcopy options: - "Rollback initiated — Undo (15s)" - "Rollback scheduled. Undo within 15s" - "Rolled back — Revert rollout" (post-action) I prefer option 1: short + actionable. Sam (Product): option 1 works. undo should be instant; no confirm modal. record telemetry. Luca (Eng): backend: idempotent cancel API then fanout. for SRs add aria-description. simple snippet:
Rollback initiated — Undo (15s)
Priya (Accessibility): notes: polite vs assertive — polite preferred to avoid interrupting. give button aria-label like "Undo rollback for release v12". avoid updating timer every second to prevent SR spam; update at key intervals only. Jin (Design): visual: current yellow (#FFF4CC) low contrast for icon. suggest darker border, 16px text, left undo icon, secondary "details" link style. minimal fade in. Marta (Design): placement: anchored to deployment card vs top-of-page toast. I like anchored for context, maybe a small global toast if user scrolled away. Luca (Eng): doable but keep single source-of-truth state. clicking either triggers same undo API. Sam (Product): MVP: anchored banner on deployment card; postpone global toast. Priya (Accessibility): ensure Undo is in tab order. only show keyboard shortcut hint if we implement global shortcut. DeployBot: rollback:v3 by @Sam triggered — environment: staging — ts 1778880042 Jin (Design): action items: update mock with option 1 copy + 15s, add aria attributes, reduced-motion styles, contrast tokens, icon variants. will push to Figma and ping thread. Priya (Accessibility): will run NVDA/VoiceOver passes on staging once shipped and provide checklist to QA. Luca (Eng): I'll implement /undo, client timer adjustable, and telemetry events: rollback.initiated, rollback.undone, rollback.timeout. Sam (Product): target: ship to staging for usability + a11y tests by EOW. :thumbsup: Marta (Design): will add note to rollout docs about pattern and when to use anchored vs global. Jin (Design): thanks — will ping when mocks live. @Luca @Priya please thumbs up when tests pass.
